definitions.explanation: A situation requiring a choice between exactly two options, with no middle ground or alternative.

examples.japanese: {二者択一|にしゃたくいつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迫|せま}られる→迫る：03928_semaru⟧。
examples.english: To be forced to make an either-or choice.

examples.japanese: {二者択一|にしゃたくいつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧。
⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{二者択一|にしゃたくいつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: It's not an either-or choice between marriage and work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{常|つね}→常：28958_tsune⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{二者択一|にしゃたくいつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I think life isn't always about either-or choices.

notes:
{二者択一|にしゃたくいつ} means having to choose one of exactly two options.

ETYMOLOGY:
- {二者|にしゃ}: two parties/things
- {択一|たくいつ}: selection of one

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {二者択一|にしゃたくいつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迫|せま}る→迫る：03928_semaru⟧: to force a binary choice
- {二者択一|にしゃたくいつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧: a binary question
- {二者択一|にしゃたくいつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: not an either-or situation

SIMILAR WORDS:
Often used to criticize oversimplified thinking that ignores nuance or middle ground solutions.

- ⟦{二項対立|にこうたいりつ}→二項対立：10757_nikoutairitsu⟧: binary opposition
